text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout started for model rwd-llm-v3 @canary (weightset w-2026-03-17). Telemetry: sudden token OOV rate +40%, tail latency spike, and 500/502s from inference nodes. Rolling checks now.
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @liam (on-call). Severity: P1 candidate. See logs -> https://internal.logs/recent?run=5412345678
liam: I'm awake, joining. Can you drop the canary traffic to 0% and hold?
maya: Confirmed encoder mismatch in a few samples — many unknown tokens mapping to [UNK]. Looks like tokenizer_v2 vs tokenizer_v2a mismatch in the artifact metadata.
jon: That would explain the OOV surge. The weightset also has a different embedding matrix mapping; model uses different vocab indices. Repro locally with sample prompt: "What's the capital of France?" -> outputs garbage tokens.
carla: Customer-facing impact: a handful of mid-tier customers saw garbled responses and increased latencies last 10m. Support already triaging open tickets. @sam-support can you confirm affected orgs?
sam-support: Two customers (acme-inc, beta-saas) reported bad responses. We've opened temporary mitigations on their side but they want ETA.
liam: Recommended immediate mitigation: flip feature flag to disable canary rollout, and do traffic cutover back to rwd-llm-v2 stable. Also start weight rollback to previous weightset w-2026-02-28.
jon: Agreed. Preparing rollback commands. Note: we should also revoke the artifact tag to prevent accidental reprovisioning.
maya: Running safety checks — if we flip the feature flag, traffic will go to stable within ~30s due to routing TTL.
carla: Informing customers: prepare short status update: "We detected degraded responses for a small subset of customers during a model canary rollout. We are rolling back to a stable model and will follow up with details." Keep it brief.
liam: Executing kill-switch now: 
```
# flip canary flag
curl -X POST https://internal.flags/flip -d '{"flag":"model_canary_rwd-llm-v3","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

liam: Flag flipped. Route controller reports canary traffic -> 0%.
maya: Starting rollback job: `rollback-controller start --service=inference --target-weightset=w-2026-02-28`
jon: Monitoring shard health and KV cache rehydration. Watching for error tail to drop.
carla: Support: can we push a short email/status page update now?
sam-support: Drafting update and sending to affected accounts.
deploy-bot: Rollback job completed on 80% of fleet, draining remaining hosts. No failed tasks.
liam: Metrics: OOV rate back down to baseline within 3m after cutover, 5xx rate normalized, tail latency improving.
maya: Verified tokenizer mapping consistent with stable. No weight corruption detected on stable. Root cause likely artifact labeling/packaging mismatch — tokenizer_v2a got bundled with weights expecting tokenizer_v2 indices.
jon: Opened an internal ticket: INF-8672 (model-artifact-packaging). Assigning to model-onboarding and CI teams.
carla: Customer update sent. No data exfiltration or PII exposure. Impact limited to quality & latency.
liam: On-call handoff note: I'll stay for 30 more minutes to watch metrics and then hand to morning shift. If anything resurfaces, page immediately.
maya: Postmortem actions: (1) add artifact checksum + tokenizer-vocab hash validation in CI, (2) block-promote step for artifact tag to verify tokenizer/weights alignment, (3) quick smoke tests on canary traffic with standardized prompts.
jon: Quick smoke test snippet we'll add: 
```
# smoke test
python smoke_check.py --model rwd-llm-v3 --prompts ./smoke-prompts/minimal.json --expect-contains "Paris"
```

sam-support: Affected customers acknowledged the rollback and appreciate the rapid response. Will track for follow-up.
liam: Closing the active pager. Logging incident and starting SLA impact calc (est. 7min window of degraded responses for ~2 customers).
deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-5412345678. Assigning to INF-8672 for root cause.
carla: Thanks team. We'll run the full postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PST. Please add notes and repro steps to INC-5412345678. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Ensure this file matches slack thread schema: single continuous string in 'text' and required metadata fields present.
